name: custom-css
description: Apply a stylesheet to electerm's own window, with the wiki examples as presets

electerm.name: Custom CSS
electerm.description: Style electerm itself. Pick one of the wiki's CSS examples, point at a CSS file, or paste your own.

configs.name: preset
configs.label: Preset
configs.description: A stylesheet from the wiki's Custom CSS examples. To combine two of them, keep one here and paste the other into the CSS box.

choices.label: SFTP panel: hide the local pane
SFTP panel: swap local and remote panes
Split view: always stack terminal above SFTP

configs.name: cssFile
configs.label: CSS file
configs.description: Optional. A .css file to apply; edited changes are picked up while the widget runs.

configs.name: css
configs.label: CSS
configs.description: Optional. Extra CSS, applied after the preset and the file.

configs.name: autoRun
configs.label: Apply on launch
configs.description: Re-apply the stylesheet on every launch. This is the switch that puts the widget in electerm's auto-run list.
